circle.title: AgentiCCells (us) (source: landscape) Sells agentic cells: small teams of AI agents (conductor, designer, writer, developer, reviewer and others), each with a role, brief and written behaviour policy, working on one focused job in the buyer's own accounts. Price: Four fixed one-off first-proposal sizes: £500 one agent or workflow, £1,500 a few sessions, £5,000 a team (about two days), £20,000 a network; none sold yet, terms may change; sovereign website launch offer £50 once.. https://agenticcells.ai/cells/ (read 2026-11-23)

Relevance AI (source: landscape) Sells an AI workforce with named agents such as Research & Enricher, Outbound Prospector, Meeting Scheduler, Deal Reviewer, Proposal Builder, Ticket Triager and Invoice Matcher. Price: Pricing page lists a single Enterprise plan via sales with no public price points and only custom vendor credits mentioned.. https://www.relevanceai.com/agents (read 2026-11-23)

11x (source: landscape) Sells AI sales agents called digital workers: Alice for outbound prospecting, Julian for inbound and expansion by voice and chat, Nina as voice agent. Price: No pricing published; visitors are directed to book a demo.. https://www.11x.ai (read 2026-11-23)

Lindy (source: landscape) Sold as seats plus monthly credit bundles, with credits metering the work the agent does. Price: Free plan with $50 credits for 7 days; Team from $29.99 per user per month with 3,000 credits pooled; top-ups $10 per 1,000 credits; Enterprise custom.. https://www.lindy.ai/pricing (read 2026-11-23)

Intercom Fin (source: landscape) Sells Fin, an AI customer service and sales agent that works with Intercom or existing helpdesks such as Zendesk, Salesforce and Freshdesk. Price: $0.99 per outcome charged at most once per conversation, nothing if the customer asks for a human; voice $1.99 per outcome; $49 per month minimum on existing helpdesk; Intercom seats $19 per month.. https://fin.ai/pricing (read 2026-11-23)

Devin (Cognition) (source: landscape) Sells Devin coding agents as individual and team plans with add-ons such as Devin Bots, Cloud and API. Price: Free $0; Pro $20 per month; Max $200 per month; Teams $80 per month up to 100 users; Enterprise custom; extra usage at API pricing.. https://devin.ai/pricing (read 2026-11-23)

Botpress (source: landscape) Sells AI agents priced on conversations handled rather than seats, with a small AI-usage allowance included per conversation. Price: Free $0 (100 conversations); Plus $150 per month and Team $750 per month billed annually; extra conversation packs of 100 at $65 or $50; Enterprise custom.. https://botpress.com/pricing (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

Salesforce Agentforce (source: landscape) Sells agent usage and licences inside its CRM suite: Flex Credits per action, per-conversation pricing, and per-user licences and add-ons. Price: Flex Credits $500 per 100k credits (20 credits per action, £400 listed in GBP); conversations $2 (£1.60); user licence $5 per user per month; Coworker licence $50 per user per month; add-ons $150 to $175 per user per month.. https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/pricing/ (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

Microsoft Copilot Studio (source: landscape) Credit packs of 25,000 credits at $200 per month, or pay-as-you-go billed monthly in arrears, or prepaid commit saving up to 20%; agents published to Microsoft 365 Copilot are covered by that licence. Price: Credit packs of 25,000 credits at $200 per month, or pay-as-you-go billed monthly in arrears, or prepaid commit saving up to 20%; agents published to Microsoft 365 Copilot are covered by that licence.. https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot/microsoft-copilot-studio (read 2026-11-23)

ServiceNow AI Agents (source: landscape) Product page returned HTTP 403, so nothing could be verified. Price: not read. https://www.servicenow.com/products/ai-agents.html (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

Google Agentspace (source: landscape) Pricing page returned 404, so nothing could be verified. CrewAI (source: landscape) Basic plan is free (visual editor, 50 workflow executions per month); Enterprise price is custom with no published figures. Price: Basic plan is free (visual editor, 50 workflow executions per month); Enterprise price is custom with no published figures.. https://www.crewai.com/pricing (read 2026-11-23)

LangChain (LangGraph and LangSmith) (source: landscape) Developer $0 per seat; Plus $39 per seat per month plus usage at $1.00 per LangChain Standard Unit; Enterprise custom invoiced annually upfront. Price: Developer $0 per seat; Plus $39 per seat per month plus usage at $1.00 per LangChain Standard Unit; Enterprise custom invoiced annually upfront.. https://www.langchain.com/pricing (read 2026-11-23)

n8n (source: landscape) Hosted Starter €20 per month (2.5K executions) and Pro €50 per month (10K) billed annually; Business €667 per month self-hosted only; Enterprise custom; Community Edition free. Price: Hosted Starter €20 per month (2.5K executions) and Pro €50 per month (10K) billed annually; Business €667 per month self-hosted only; Enterprise custom; Community Edition free.. https://n8n.io/pricing/ (read 2026-11-23)

Zapier (source: landscape) Agents are an add-on billed in activities (Free 400 per month, Pro 1,500 per month from about $33.33 per month annual), separate from task plans. Price: Pro 750 tasks $19.99 per month annual ($29.99 monthly); Team from 2,000 tasks $69 annual; Free 100 tasks; annual billing 33% off; 19 currencies.. https://zapier.com/pricing (read 2026-11-23)

Dust (source: landscape) Pro €24 per seat per month billed yearly (8,000 credits), Max €120 (40,000 credits), Free €0 with 500 lifetime credits; Enterprise custom. Price: Pro €24 per seat per month billed yearly (8,000 credits), Max €120 (40,000 credits), Free €0 with 500 lifetime credits; Enterprise custom.. https://dust.tt/pricing (read 2026-11-23)

Make (source: landscape) AI agents appear in the marketing copy but have no separate pricing on the page. Price: Billing is by credits (Free 1,000 per month), with bundles of 1,000 or 10,000; the fetched page showed no dollar prices.. https://www.make.com/en/pricing (read 2026-11-23)

svg.text: Green: user need. Purple: the shared goal. Blue: component. Red ring: a gap (named as missing in the sources). Orange arrow: a suggested move, for strategy.d. Faint dashed: low confidence. Positions are a reading of the sources.
